products.title: Organic Cotton Dish Towels
products.description: A set of three generously sized dish towels woven from GOTS-certified organic cotton, with a waffle weave that actually dries a plate instead of pushing the water around. They soften with every wash, hang from a sewn-in loop, and go on the compost heap in shreds when a decade of use finally finishes them.
products.seoTitle: Organic Cotton Dish Towels — set of three waffle-weave towels
products.seoDescription: A set of three GOTS-certified organic cotton waffle-weave dish towels that soften with every wash.

attributes.fabric: Woven from GOTS-certified organic cotton in a waffle structure that traps water and actually dries a plate instead of pushing it around. Generously sized, hemmed flat, and finished with a sewn-in hanging loop.
attributes.fit: A set of three, sized for real drying — big enough for a stack of plates, not a token square. They soften and grow more absorbent with every wash.
attributes.care: Machine wash warm with like colours and tumble or line dry; skip fabric softener, which coats the cotton and stops it absorbing. Bleach-free, and compostable in shreds once a decade of use finishes them.

products.title: Beeswax Food Wraps
products.description: The plastic wrap you never throw away. Organic cotton dipped in beeswax, tree resin and jojoba oil, so the warmth of your hands moulds it around a bowl, a lemon half or a loaf of bread. Wash it in cool water, use it for a year or more, then compost it or wrap it round kindling to light a fire.
products.seoTitle: Beeswax Food Wraps — reusable plastic-free food wraps
products.seoDescription: Organic cotton beeswax wraps that mould to a bowl with the warmth of your hands and compost at the end.

attributes.fabric: Organic cotton dipped in a blend of beeswax, tree resin and jojoba oil, so the warmth of your hands moulds it around a bowl, a lemon half or a loaf. The wax makes it cling; the cotton makes it last.
attributes.fit: A mixed set of small, medium and large squares — enough to cover most bowls and to fold around a sandwich or a block of cheese. Re-waxable, so a tired wrap comes back rather than going in the bin.
attributes.care: Wash in cool water with a little mild soap and air-dry flat — no heat, no dishwasher, and not around raw meat. Re-wax with a grated block in a warm oven when the cling fades; compost it at the very end.

products.title: Bamboo Utensil Set
products.description: Five kitchen tools — spoon, slotted spoon, spatula, turner and salad fork — carved from a single stand of fast-growing bamboo, which grows back faster than any hardwood we could have used. Kind to a non-stick pan, warm in the hand, and finished with a food-safe oil you can refresh in a minute.
products.seoTitle: Bamboo Utensil Set — five-piece fast-growing bamboo kitchen tools
products.seoDescription: A five-piece bamboo utensil set, kind to non-stick pans and finished in food-safe oil.

attributes.fabric: Carved from a single stand of fast-growing bamboo — which regrows quicker than any hardwood — and finished with a food-safe oil. Five tools: a spoon, a slotted spoon, a spatula, a turner and a salad fork.
attributes.fit: A five-piece set sized for everyday cooking — warm and light in the hand, kind to a non-stick pan, and long enough to keep knuckles off a hot pan edge.
attributes.care: Hand-wash in warm soapy water and dry upright — never the dishwasher, which splits wood over time. Refresh the finish in a minute with a food-safe oil when the grain starts to look dry.

products.title: Linen Tea Towels
products.description: A pair of tea towels woven from European flax linen — the fibre that needs almost no water or spray to grow, and gets softer and more absorbent the more you use it. Lint-free for a polished glass, quick to dry so they never turn musty, and finished with a hanging loop and a plainly stitched edge.
products.seoTitle: Linen Tea Towels — pair of European flax linen towels
products.seoDescription: A pair of lint-free European flax linen tea towels that soften and absorb more with use.

attributes.fabric: Woven from European flax linen — the fibre that grows on rain alone and gets softer and more absorbent the more you use it. Lint-free for a polished glass, with a plainly stitched edge and a hanging loop.
attributes.fit: A pair, cut long for a proper grip on a hot pan and quick to dry so they never turn musty between washes. They break in over the first few washes and only improve from there.
attributes.care: Machine wash warm and line or tumble dry; linen actually likes being used and washed. A press with a warm iron while slightly damp keeps them crisp, though creased is honest too.

products.title: Castile Soap Bars
products.description: A trio of hard-milled castile soap bars made from olive and coconut oil and nothing you cannot pronounce — no palm oil, no synthetic fragrance, no plastic. One bar does the sink, the shower and the hands, lasts for weeks, and arrives wrapped in paper you can plant or compost.
products.seoTitle: Castile Soap Bars — set of three olive-oil soap bars
products.seoDescription: A trio of hard-milled olive and coconut castile soap bars, palm-oil-free and plastic-free.

attributes.fabric: Hard-milled from olive and coconut oil and nothing you cannot pronounce — no palm oil, no synthetic fragrance, no plastic. A trio of long-lasting bars wrapped in paper you can compost or plant.
attributes.fit: Three full-size bars; one does the sink, the shower and the hands and lasts for weeks. Sized to sit in a dish without going to mush between uses.
attributes.care: Keep the bar on a draining dish so it dries between uses — a soaking bar is a bar you waste. Cool water or warm, it lathers either way, and the paper wrap composts.

products.title: Wool Dryer Balls
products.description: Six balls of dense New Zealand wool that replace single-use dryer sheets for good. They bounce between your clothes to cut drying time by a quarter, soften without any coating, and take a few drops of essential oil if you like a scent. They last for a thousand loads, then go on the compost.
products.seoTitle: Wool Dryer Balls — set of six New Zealand wool dryer balls
products.seoDescription: Six New Zealand wool dryer balls that cut drying time and replace single-use dryer sheets.

attributes.fabric: Six balls of dense, felted New Zealand wool and nothing else. They bounce between damp clothes in the dryer to lift and separate them, cutting drying time and softening without any coating or scent.
attributes.fit: A set of six — the number it takes to make a real difference to a full load; add a few drops of essential oil if you like a scent. They last for a thousand loads and then compost.
attributes.care: Just use them — they need no washing. If they pill, a quick run in a hot dryer re-felts the surface. Store them dry between loads so the wool never sits damp.

products.title: Coconut Scrub Brushes
products.description: A pair of dish brushes with beechwood handles and stiff coconut-coir bristles that scour a burnt pan without a scrap of plastic. When the head finally wears down you unclip it for the compost and click a fresh one onto the same handle — a brush you refill instead of replace.
products.seoTitle: Coconut Scrub Brushes — pair of refillable dish brushes
products.seoDescription: A pair of beechwood dish brushes with compostable coconut-coir heads you refill, not replace.

attributes.fabric: Beechwood handles and stiff coconut-coir bristles that scour a burnt pan without a scrap of plastic. The head clips off for the compost when it wears down; a fresh one clicks onto the same handle.
attributes.fit: A pair, so there is a dry one while the other drains — sized to fit the hand and reach the bottom of a pan. A refillable design: you replace the head, not the whole brush.
attributes.care: Rinse and stand it bristle-up to dry so the wood never sits in water. When the coir softens, unclip the head for the compost and click on a replacement.

products.title: Seagrass Storage Baskets
products.description: A hand-woven basket of seagrass — a plant that regrows in the shallows and needs no farming at all — with sturdy handles and a soft, structured shape that holds its form under a load of blankets, toys or firewood. Every one is woven by hand, so no two are exactly alike, and it lasts for years of daily lifting.
products.seoTitle: Seagrass Storage Baskets — hand-woven seagrass baskets
products.seoDescription: A hand-woven seagrass storage basket with sturdy handles that holds its shape under a load.

attributes.fabric: Hand-woven from seagrass — a plant that regrows in the shallows and needs no farming — over a sturdy frame, with woven handles and a soft, structured shape that holds its form under a load.
attributes.fit: Offered in two sizes for blankets, toys or firewood; every basket is woven by hand, so no two are exactly alike. Sized to sit on a shelf or on the floor beside a sofa.
attributes.care: Dust it out or wipe with a barely-damp cloth; keep it out of standing water, as any natural fibre dislikes staying wet. Reshape it by hand if it takes a knock — seagrass is forgiving.

products.title: Glass Storage Jars
products.description: A set of thick recycled-glass jars with a bamboo lid and a silicone seal, for the pantry staples that used to live in plastic. You can see what is in them, they wash in the machine forever, and glass is the one material you can recycle again and again with nothing lost. Airtight enough for flour, coffee or the good biscuits.
products.seoTitle: Glass Storage Jars — recycled-glass pantry jars with bamboo lids
products.seoDescription: A set of airtight recycled-glass storage jars with bamboo lids and silicone seals for the pantry.

attributes.fabric: Thick recycled glass with a bamboo lid and a silicone seal, so you can see what is inside and recycle the glass again and again with nothing lost. Airtight enough for flour, coffee or the good biscuits.
attributes.fit: A set in two counts, sized for the pantry staples that used to live in plastic; the jars stack and line up cleanly on a shelf. The bamboo lid wipes clean and the seal lifts out to wash.
attributes.care: The glass jar is dishwasher-safe forever; hand-wash the bamboo lid and let it dry rather than soaking it. Replace the silicone seal on its own if it ever perishes, not the whole jar.

products.title: Stoneware Mug Set
products.description: Four mugs thrown from local stoneware clay and glazed in a soft matte that breaks to bare clay at the rim. They hold a proper amount of coffee, keep it warm, and are heavy enough to feel like something. Fired once, kept for years, and made from clay dug rather than a resin poured.
products.seoTitle: Stoneware Mug Set — set of four hand-glazed stoneware mugs
products.seoDescription: A set of four stoneware mugs in a soft matte glaze that breaks to bare clay at the rim.

attributes.fabric: Thrown from local stoneware clay and glazed in a soft matte that breaks to bare clay at the rim. Fired hard so it holds heat, and heavy enough in the hand to feel like something.
attributes.fit: A set of four, each holding a proper amount of coffee; because they are glazed by hand, the colour varies a little cup to cup. Sized for everyday use, not a display shelf.
attributes.care: Dishwasher- and microwave-safe, though a quick hand-wash keeps the matte glaze at its best. Warm the cup with hot water first on a cold morning and it holds the heat longer.

products.title: Stoneware Serving Bowl
products.description: A wide, low serving bowl thrown by hand from stoneware clay — big enough for a salad for the table or a bowl of fruit on the counter, and handsome enough to leave out. The speckled oatmeal glaze suits whatever you put in it, and stoneware simply outlasts the plastic and melamine it replaces.
products.seoTitle: Stoneware Serving Bowl — wide hand-thrown serving bowl
products.seoDescription: A wide, low hand-thrown stoneware serving bowl in a speckled oatmeal glaze.

attributes.fabric: A wide, low bowl thrown by hand from stoneware clay in a speckled oatmeal glaze that suits whatever you put in it. Substantial enough to sit out on the counter and handsome enough to leave there.
attributes.fit: Big enough for a salad for the table or a bowl of fruit on the side; each one is hand-thrown, so the size and the speckle vary slightly. One generous bowl, not a nesting set.
attributes.care: Dishwasher-safe and hard-wearing; a hand-wash keeps the glaze looking its best over years. Bring it up to room temperature before a hot oven if you serve straight from the heat.

products.title: Organic Cotton Bath Towels
products.description: A pair of bath towels woven from long-staple organic cotton, thirsty from the first wash rather than the tenth and free of the softening coatings that stop cheaper towels absorbing at all. Undyed or coloured with low-impact dye, hemmed to hold their shape, and the kind of everyday thing worth buying once and keeping.
products.seoTitle: Organic Cotton Bath Towels — pair of long-staple cotton towels
products.seoDescription: A pair of long-staple organic cotton bath towels, thirsty from the first wash and free of softening coatings.

attributes.fabric: Woven from long-staple organic cotton, thirsty from the first wash rather than the tenth and free of the softening coatings that stop cheaper towels absorbing. Undyed or coloured with low-impact dye, and hemmed to hold their shape.
attributes.fit: A pair of full-size bath towels, dense enough to dry properly and to last years of daily use. They plump up over the first few washes and stay soft without any additives.
attributes.care: Machine wash warm and tumble dry on low; skip the fabric softener, which is exactly what stops a towel absorbing. Wash new towels once before first use to set the pile.
